Lina: morning — quick runway check for today. who wants the 14:00 UTC release runway? need a smoke owner and a rollback tag.
Devon: I can own the 14:00 UTC infra deploy. assigning smoke to @Priya. rollback tag: release/infra-20240401-rc1
Priya: noted, i'll run the smoke from canaries and verify p50/p95, mem, and 5 sample prompts. smoke finish ETA +15m after deploy.
Sam: i have a 15:30 minor model-tweak planned, can be secondary for rollback if needed. heads-up: maintenance scheduled during that time, ops?
Ops: @Sam there's a kernel patch in us-west 15:15-15:45; i'd recommend moving to 16:00 or doing blue/green. :warning:
Sam: ack — will move to 16:00 then. @Lina please reassign my 15:30 slot.
Lina: schedule updated: Devon 14:00, Sam 16:00. @Andre can you be on-call for Devon's 14:00 deploy?
Andre: yep, i'll be on. i'll run the smoke checklist: `./smoke.sh && curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/health || true` and tail the last logs.
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted: devon/release/infra-20240401 -> prod @ 14:00 UTC. Runbook: runbook/RI-231.
Devon: starting prep now. deploy command: `./deploy.sh prod --tag infra-20240401-rc1 --canary 10%`
Priya: smoke started 14:03 — cpu/mem stable, p50 ~37ms, p95 ~122ms. kicking off prompt sample tests.
Priya: smoke complete 14:07 — all checks green, sample outputs look fine. :white_check_mark:
Lina: nice. roll to 50% over next 10m. @devex please note perf delta in docs.
Devon: rolling to 50% now. logs: `INFO rollout: canary=50% progress=started`
Devon: rolled to 50% at 14:15, monitoring window 10m.
Priya: after 10m monitoring, error rate within baseline, approving full rollout at 14:25.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed: 100% at 14:25 UTC for devon/release/infra-20240401.
Andre: post-deploy checks done, no rollback required. archiving runbook RI-231.
Sam: confirmed i've moved my change to 16:00 and will post a start message in this thread before kickoff.
Lina: thanks all — i'll spin up a short retro doc for perf delta and cost impact. :sparkles:
